description: This file implements cryptography-related classes and functions, including interfaces for cryptography operations, vault management, and cryptographic primitives, with internal classes for RPC-based communication and object management.

classes.name: CryptographyLink
classes.description: Manages RPC connection to cryptography plugin, provides access to cryptography interfaces and device objects.

classes.name: RPCVaultImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IVault interface, manages vault data and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: RPCCryptographyImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for ICryptography interface, provides access to cryptographic primitives and vaults.

classes.name: RandomImpl
classes.description: Local implementation of IRandom using internal random_generate function.

classes.name: HashImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IHash wrapping hash_create and hash_destroy.

classes.name: VaultImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IVault and IPersistent, manages vault data and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: CryptographyImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ICryptography providing access to random, hash, and vault interfaces.

methods.name: Cryptography
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ICryptography interface, either local or via RPC based on connection point.
